pages.title: Digital UI
pages.text: For UI engineers and web designers. Values are the brand tokens, in the downloads as JSON (brand.tokens.json), CSS custom properties (tokens.css, --climb-*) and SCSS variables (_tokens.scss, $climb-*), so any platform can use them.

pages.title: Motion
pages.text: For motion designers, front-end engineers and animators. pages.title: Photography
pages.text: For event photographers, designers choosing images and anyone briefing a shoot. Photography carries most of the festival feel: the type and colour are the poster, the photos are the reason to come.

pages.title: Video
pages.text: For videographers, editors and animators. Motion values (durations, curves, the logo sting) are in the Motion section; this page is how a ClimbUK film should look and sound. The rule of thumb: it should feel like the best ten minutes of the festival, not a conference recording.

pages.title: Print, merch and signage
pages.text: For printers, merch suppliers, sign makers and anyone sending artwork to press. Sizes and safe zones for each item come with its template in the downloads; this page is how to make them come out right.

pages.title: Press and partners
pages.text: For journalists, publishers, partners, sponsors, speakers and anyone putting ClimbUK next to their own name. Words follow the Voice section.

pages.title: Email signatures
pages.text: For whoever manages the company email signatures, and anyone adding ClimbUK buttons to an email, a footer or a share kit.

pages.title: Voice
pages.text: For anyone writing words for ClimbUK, ClimbGroup or Climb27: marketers, agencies, partners, speakers, journalists and the people who write the website, emails, social posts, scripts and signs.
